description: Build a subscribable calendar of upcoming Bay Area events from the user's interests. Returns a link that opens the calendar on SFomo (open_on_sfomo; give the user this first), subscribe links (Google Calendar, Apple/Outlook webcal, plain .ics) and a preview. The calendar refreshes itself every few hours, so new matching events keep appearing. An event is included if it matches ANY interest and no exclude term. Nothing is stored by SFomo: the interests are encoded in the link itself. Interview the user first (see the custom_calendar prompt), check matches with search_events, and call this again to adjust.

exclude.description: Words; any event containing one is left out

interests.description: 1-12 interests; each needs a query, category or topic

near.description: Events within radius_km of a place: a neighborhood, a town, a venue name, or "lat,lon". Results get distance_km, nearest first within each day. Use this for "near X"; use neighborhood for "in X". Unmapped venues are left out (counted in place.unplaced_events).

neighborhood.description: Only events in this San Francisco neighborhood (or town): Bayview, Bernal Heights, Castro, Chinatown, Excelsior, FiDi / South Beach, Glen Park, Golden Gate Park, Haight, Hayes Valley, Ingleside / Oceanview, Inner Richmond, Inner Sunset, Japantown, Lakeshore, Lincoln Park, Lone Mountain / USF, Marina, McLaren Park, Mission, Mission Bay, Nob Hill, Noe Valley, North Beach, Outer Mission, Outer Richmond, Pacific Heights, Portola, Potrero Hill, Presidio, Presidio Heights, Russian Hill, Seacliff, SoMa, Sunset / Parkside, Tenderloin, Treasure Island, Twin Peaks, Visitacion Valley, West of Twin Peaks, Western Addition. Sub-neighborhood and common names work too. Add radius_km to also take events within that distance of its centre. Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out; the response's place.unplaced_events counts them.

query.description: Words that must ALL appear in the event's title/location/organizer/tags, e.g. 'salsa', 'hackathon', 'trail run'. Make separate interests for alternatives.

radius_km.description: Distance for near (default 1.5, max 50), or how far neighborhood reaches past its boundary (default 0)

times.description: Start times, local: morning 5-12, afternoon 12-17, evening 17-21, late 21+; allday = no set time (fairs, exhibits). Default all

name.description: Calendar name shown in their calendar app, e.g. 'Salsa + AI nights'

name: create_custom_calendar
title: Create a custom calendar
